tools.name: analyze_headers
tools.description: Analyze pasted raw email headers. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: analyze_headers · Public sink: analyze_headers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: analyze_headers · Public sink: analyze_headers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
